main_claim: Justin Gaethje, who beat Topuria at UFC Freedom 250, says the game plan was to disrupt Topuria's footwork because he never moves laterally or changes the rhythm of his feet.
note: Gaethje ('He never changes the rhythm of his feet... you very rarely see him moving laterally', 'not fully prepared') assesses the opponent he already fought; the second half is Gaethje's own knee bruise and 'I will not be fighting again this year', so Topuria shares the stage (centrality could be read as main_subject from the headline). The June loss and 'serious injuries' are the writer's recap, and 'talks about a potential rematch... will not be happening this year' is the writer's closing-line inference with no who, when or where, so no_fact and next fight no, though an editor could read it as a rematch postponed.
